title: A gate whose question names a constant such as DISPATCH_BASE_TOKENS is classed secrets by the word token inside the identifier
goal: class_reasons does not read the word token inside an upper-case identifier of token counts (DISPATCH_BASE_TOKENS, MAX_TOKENS) as a secret, so a gate about a token-count constant gets the class its touches and other words give; a gate whose text says token only as the name of the ops-row value shape (a phase token, a closed token) is classed design, not secrets, while one naming a credential, an API key or a bearer token stays secrets

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bl_authority as a; sys.exit(0 if a.class_reasons({'touches':['_tools/census.py']},{'id':'g9','question':'What is census.DISPATCH_BASE_TOKENS?','options':[]})[0]=='design' else 1)

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_authority as a
def cls(touches, q, options=()):
    return a.class_reasons({'touches': touches}, {'id': 'g9', 'question': q, 'options': list(options)})[0]
design = [cls([], 'Which phase token does the ops row carry?', ['apply', 'record']),
          cls([], 'Does the closed token of the ops row stay a free word?')]
secret = [cls([], 'Which bearer token does the job send?'), cls([], 'Is the API token rotated?'),
          cls([], 'May the credential in tokens.json be read?'), cls([], 'Is GITLAB_TOKEN passed to the job?')]
sys.exit(0 if design == ['design'] * 2 and secret == ['secrets'] * 4 else 1)

gates.recommendation: only those holding TOKENS in the plural (DISPATCH_BASE_TOKENS, MAX_TOKENS); a singular such as GITLAB_TOKEN stays secrets
gates.answer: only those holding TOKENS in the plural (DISPATCH_BASE_TOKENS, MAX_TOKENS); a singular such as GITLAB_TOKEN stays secrets

gates.question: Which words before token name the ops-row value shape that is no secret?
options: only phase and closed (phase token, closed token)
any word before token that is not a credential word
gates.recommendation: only phase and closed (phase token, closed token)
gates.answer: only phase and closed (phase token, closed token)
